options: A rule for deleting bad rows
A number that measures how wrong the model's predictions are; training tries to make it small
The list of features used by the model
A way to split data into train and test sets
questions.explain: A loss function compares predictions with true answers and returns one number. Optimization searches for parameters that minimize it.

questions.q: Four predictions are off by about $1-2k and one is off by $30k. Compared with MAE, MSE will:
options: Be dominated by the $30k miss, because errors are squared
questions.explain: Squaring makes large errors count disproportionately, so MSE is much more sensitive to outliers than MAE.

questions.q: Which loss is the standard choice for a classifier that outputs probabilities?
questions.explain: Log loss penalizes confident wrong probabilities heavily and rewards honest probabilities.

questions.q: In gradient descent, what does the learning rate control?
options: The size of each step taken downhill on the loss
questions.explain: Each step moves the parameters against the gradient, scaled by the learning rate.

questions.q: In the lesson's experiment, the loss exploded to billions with a learning rate of 1.05. Why?
options: The steps were so large they overshot the minimum and landed higher on the other side each time
The learning rate was too small
The model had too few parameters
questions.explain: Too large a learning rate overshoots the valley on every step, so the loss grows instead of shrinking. This is divergence.
